finding: THE CONTENTION LOG HAD NO PRODUCER
before: four decisions on disk, every one typed by hand. Nothing in the repository wrote CONTENTION_DECISIONS.jsonl; autonomy_ratio.py only READ it. G014 requires a recorded decision EACH TIME lanes are paused or reaped for the resident, and 'each time' was enforced by memory -- which is not enforcement. A pause nobody remembered to write down leaves no trace, and an incomplete record is indistinguishable from a complete one.
fix: tools/future/contention.py. decide(subject, expected_gb, lanes) takes the decision against a LIVE guard reading and has already recorded it when it returns -- recording is not a separate step a caller can forget. record() REFUSES a decision carrying no guard reading, and refuses a reading with no measured state.

acceptance_a.requirement: a recorded decision each time lanes are paused/reaped, with the guard reading that forced it
acceptance_a.status: MECHANISM IN PLACE AND BOTH BRANCHES PROVEN
acceptance_a.honest_limit: no pause has EVER occurred in production -- all five recorded decisions are 'allowed', because the guard has never said STOP during contention. The pause branch is therefore proven by INJECTION, not by a live event. That is the strongest evidence available: verifying it by waiting for real memory pressure means verifying it by waiting for a failure.

acceptance_b.requirement: two distinct counters in the autonomy receipt
acceptance_b.note: autonomy_ratio.py prints 'no ratio is printed: the two counters are not commensurable' and never averages them

newest_decision_taken_by_the_producer.subject: superwave-2 (BLOCKED: Grok balance exhausted) + round21b-resident
newest_decision_taken_by_the_producer.why: the guard reading is live and it SEES the resident -- residents 1, RSS 11.17 GB -- which the executable-basename fix earlier this campaign made possible. An earlier decision in this same log recorded residents 0 while a 12 GB resident was running.

covers: STOP guard -> paused, carrying the reasons that forced it
no guard reading -> ValueError, prose refused as evidence
selftest.mutation: two mutations, both caught: (a) pause branch forced to always allow -> the STOP case fails AND the decision no longer carries the forcing reading; (b) the no-guard refusal replaced with a defaulted snapshot -> prose is recorded and the entry count goes wrong. Restored green, marker grep 0.
selftest.hygiene: the selftest writes two entries and removes them, and asserts the log is restored to its prior length. A test that pollutes the record it is testing corrupts the evidence for the obligation it serves.

what_this_does_not_claim: that contention has been exercised under real pressure. It has not. It claims the decision is now taken by a producer against a measured state, that both branches work, and that a decision without evidence cannot be recorded at all.
scar: A LOG WITH NO WRITER IS A HABIT, NOT A CONTROL. Ask what would happen if the person stopped remembering.
